tokens.name: ink-cream
tokens.usage: Cream background, the brand's main surface. Page background; never white.

tokens.name: ink-brown
tokens.usage: Brand brown (the logo's, the official one). Text on cream and inverted surface.

tokens.name: ink-gold
tokens.usage: Mustard/gold, the brand's sun. Accent, pills and CTA fill; text on it in brown-700 or brown-900.

tokens.name: ink-olive
tokens.usage: Olive green, herbal secondary. Seasoning in menu and campaign pieces; text on it in cream-100.

tokens.name: ink-terracotta
tokens.usage: Terracotta, warm secondary. Seasoning in menu and campaign pieces; text on it in brown-900.

tokens.name: brown-900
tokens.usage: Deepest ink. Only maximum-contrast surfaces and text on gold; not for headings on cream.

tokens.name: brown-800
tokens.usage: Deep ink (historic brown). Dark surface and text on gold; not for headings on cream.

tokens.name: brown-700
tokens.usage: Same as ink-brown. Heading and body text on cream-50/100/200 and inverted surface.

tokens.name: brown-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text on cream-50/100/200 (5.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: brown-500
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on cream (3.6 to 4.1:1): only from 24px or in large labels.

tokens.name: brown-400
tokens.usage: Middle step of the brown ramp; borders and details, not text.

tokens.name: brown-300
tokens.usage: Strong border of outline controls and blocks on cream.

tokens.name: brown-200
tokens.usage: Muted text on brown-700 (6.3:1) and soft rules on cream.

tokens.name: brown-100
tokens.usage: Very light brown wash; hover background of outline and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: gold-800
tokens.usage: Readable gold text on cream-50/100/200 and gold-100 (5.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: gold-700
tokens.usage: Dark gold; base of the warning colour. Do not use as text on cream.

tokens.name: gold-600
tokens.usage: Middle step of the gold ramp.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Same as ink-gold. The sun: accent, pills, CTA and focus ring.

tokens.name: gold-400
tokens.usage: Soft gold; dotted rule of the menu notes and accent text on dark photos.

tokens.name: gold-300
tokens.usage: Light gold; English line and accent text on brown-700 (5.5:1).

tokens.name: gold-200
tokens.usage: Background of date labels and soft pills; text selection.

tokens.name: gold-100
tokens.usage: Very light gold background of highlighted notes; text on it in brown-700.

tokens.name: terra-700
tokens.usage: Dark terracotta; text, or fill under cream-100 text (5.7:1).

tokens.name: terra-600
tokens.usage: Medium terracotta; campaign subtitle text on cream.

tokens.name: terra-500
tokens.usage: Same as ink-terracotta. Fill of labels and pills; text on it in brown-900.

tokens.name: terra-300
tokens.usage: Light terracotta; details and soft fills.

tokens.name: terra-100
tokens.usage: Very light terracotta background for soft chips.

tokens.name: olive-700
tokens.usage: Dark olive; surface under cream-100 text.

tokens.name: olive-500
tokens.usage: Same as ink-olive. Fill of labels and blocks; text on it in cream-100 (7.7:1).

tokens.name: olive-300
tokens.usage: Light olive; details and soft fills.

tokens.name: olive-100
tokens.usage: Very light olive background for soft chips.

tokens.name: cream-50
tokens.usage: The lightest surface of the system (never pure white). Cards and raised surfaces.

tokens.name: cream-100
tokens.usage: Same as ink-cream. Page background and text on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: cream-200
tokens.usage: Sunken cream; panels and surfaces below the page.

tokens.name: cream-400
tokens.usage: Default border of fields and separators on cream.

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Medium warm neutral; details, not text.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background (cream-100). Always cream, never white.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sunken surface, panels below the page (cream-200).

tokens.name: surface-invert
tokens.usage: Inverted surface in brand brown; text on it in text-on-dark.

tokens.name: surface-ink
tokens.usage: Maximum-contrast blocks (brown-900); text on it in text-on-dark.

tokens.name: surface-gold
tokens.usage: Soft gold background for notes; text on it in text-on-gold.

tokens.name: surface-gold-solid
tokens.usage: Solid gold fill (CTA, prices); text on it in text-on-gold (6.7:1).

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings on surface-page, surface-raised and surface-sunken (7.3:1 or more). It is the brand brown, never a blackish ink.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body text on surface-page, surface-raised and surface-sunken (7.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-page, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on surface-page (3.9:1), surface-raised (4.1:1) and surface-sunken (3.6:1): below 4.5:1, so only from 24px or in large labels. Original value, kept.

tokens.name: text-gold
tokens.usage: Gold readable as text on surface-page, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-en
tokens.usage: English line under the Spanish name, on surface-page and surface-sunken (5.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: 1px rule on cream (cream-300). Decorative, low contrast.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Default border of fields and separators (cream-400, 1.5:1 on the page). For controls that need 3:1 use border-strong or border-ink.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Marked border of outline buttons and blocks (brown-300, 1.7:1 on the page).

tokens.name: border-ink
tokens.usage: Border in brand brown (brown-700); meets 3:1 on cream.

tokens.name: border-on-dark
tokens.usage: Translucent rule on brown surfaces (cream at 22%). Decorative.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Gold focus ring (gold-500). On surface-page it gives 2.2:1 and on surface-invert 3.6:1: below 3:1 on cream; original value, kept (ring-gold reinforces it with a halo).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state on surface-page and surface-raised (5.6:1 or more). Always pair with text or an icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state (gold-700). On surface-page it gives 3.4:1: use as a fill or with text in text-on-gold, not as text. Pair with text or an icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error state on surface-page and surface-raised (6.2:1 or more). Always pair with text or an icon; success and danger are not told apart by hue alone.

styles.name: type-eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow or section label: uppercase, in text-gold on cream (--type-eyebrow-*).

styles.name: type-ui
styles.usage: Controls and UI (--type-ui-*). Buttons and tabs are uppercase with tracking-wide or tracking-wider.

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: Display hero (text-5xl). Campaign pieces go up to weight 800 (fw-black).

styles.name: type-hero
styles.usage: Hero (text-4xl). Heading on cream in text-strong.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: Section title (text-2xl, --type-title-*). Default weight 700; campaign pieces use 800.

styles.name: type-subtitle
styles.usage: Subtitle one step below the title (--type-subtitle-*).

styles.name: type-en
styles.usage: English line under the Spanish name, always Montserrat italic in text-en (--type-en-*). Never in brackets or in Lora.

styles.name: type-price
styles.usage: Prices in Montserrat semibold; turn on font-feature-settings "tnum" 1 to align columns (--type-price-*).

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: El sabor del Perú, con alma de casa.
styles.usage: Body text and prose in Lora, in text-body (--type-body-*).

styles.name: type-dish
styles.usage: Dish and menu names in Lora weight 500 (--type-serif-*).

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page container.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the wide container (covers and menu grids).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, labels and price pills.

tokens.name: ring-gold
tokens.usage: Gold focus halo at 35%, to reinforce focus-ring. Shadows are always brown, never bluish.

tokens.name: fw-medium
tokens.usage: 500; dish names in Lora and wordmark.
